summary: Test RF with nested CV on pilot (K in {10,25,50}) and check heldout-strong features' pilot ranks
reasoning: Pilot F-ranks are noisy; the signal appears to be interaction-based (madelon). A random forest can use weak-marginal features jointly. I'll (a) see where heldout-strong features rank in pilot (can a pilot screen capture them?), (b) nested-CV on pilot (screen inside folds, K tuned by inner CV) to get honest cv_auc per procedure. Expect capture of most real features within top-50 and cv_auc around 0.70-0.75; if pilot CV is far below 0.70 for all K, the route needs a better screen.
